independence_evidence: Contact page lists 'A PUBLISHER SAS, Paris, France' as publisher with KD Presse handling online sales and subscriptions; a small independent Paris publishing company that also makes brand-commissioned 'Curated For' editions, but the magazine itself is its own title and no media group is involved.
qualifies_reason: Independent Paris fashion title with N°30 launched in October 2026 and N°28 and N°29 printed in 2025.
what_it_is: A Magazine Curated By hands each issue to a single guest fashion designer or house, who fills it with their own references: photography, art, music, places and friends, rather than conventional fashion coverage. N°30 is curated by Hiroshi Fujiwara and is built around Tokyo, record shops, his hometown of Ise and his collaborators, with a 300-copy limited edition that includes a vinyl record. It suits readers interested in designers' thinking and visual culture, and collectors of fashion publications.
